newsitem.title: UK: UK shares start firmer but cautious ahead of RPI.
newsitem.headline: UK shares start firmer but cautious ahead of RPI.

text.p: Leading UK shares opened higher on Thursday, pepped up by the U.S. Federal Reserve's decision to leave interest rates unchanged after its latest monetary policy meeting and a string of positive company news, traders said.
The FTSE 100 added 12.3 points to 3,939.2 early after well-received second quarter results from British Telecom, and first half figures from South West Water and PowerGen.

News of Great Universal Stores' (GUS) 1.05 billion stg takeover of Experian, a Californian supplier of credit, marketing and real estate information services was also welcomed. GUS shares rose 21p to 611-1/2p.
